captions_note: the cards and the note are the effect; the reel's captions keep running in front of them. Set the STYLE block to the reel's look: the card lines take the reel's second voice
in_a_reel: one continuous shot, about 5.5 s or more. The speaker stays in front of the cards through the cutout
the cards are the reel's own shots with the line each shot says (segments.json). NOTE_TITLE, NOTE_LINES and NOTE_ROWS are the speaker's own words and true facts of the reel: never invent one
the deck lands on the side with more wall beside the head; build.py stops when there is no room
steps: edit NOTE_TITLE, NOTE_LINES and NOTE_ROWS in the CLIP block: the speaker's own words and true facts
run build.py SAFE=1      # pulls the frames, prints the beats, the side and the snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
